impact.text: Now the main problem is when our ``_credit()`` fails due to ``blacklisted``,  our ``100 iTRY`` tokens are still locked in ``iTryTokenOFTAdapter()`` with no ``rescue`` mechanism.

precondition_sources.text: Alice has completed the cooldown for 100 iTRY tokens.

intent_sources.text: When a blacklisted user's unstake credit fails, the user's iTRY tokens must not remain locked in iTryTokenOFTAdapter without a rescue mechanism.
